title: 29 Drug Batches, Including Haloperidol, Amikacin, Rabeprazole Fail CDSCO Quality Tests
summary: New Delhi: The Central Drugs Standard Control Organisation (CDSCO) has listed 29 batches of drugs, surgical products, and a pharmaceutical ingredient as Not of Standard Quality (NSQ) in its central...
